caption: The drawing depicts a single smoking pipe positioned upright and at a slight angle on a plain, light beige background. The pipe consists of three distinct segments: the mouthpiece at the top, which is curved and colored in an off-white or ivory tone with some translucent qualities; a short black section connects the mouthpiece to the stem. The stem is elongated and a warm, medium brown, resembling polished wood, with visible subtle texture and highlights. The bowl at the bottom of the pipe is rounded and predominantly a light, yellowish-brown shade with darker brown and black details around the rim and inside the bowl, suggesting a used appearance. The artist's name, "John Hall," is written in uppercase, brown-red letters near the bottom center of the image. There are no additional objects or background elements present.
title: Pipe
